The rider's claim therefore turns on whether any exculpatory clause reduces the excess, and on the billing-integrity route under POL-RD-09(4), which is available whether or not a deviation exists.

The driver's explanation for the extra distance is a road-works sign. That is an assertion of an external traffic cause, and under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02841-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0. The POL-RD-03 comparison therefore cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the driver's traffic assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver's alternative reading of the trip is that the rider asked for the detour. There is no such instruction anywhere on the record: the chat log for this trip carries zero messages, message_count 0, first_message_at null and last_message_at null. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within three minutes after, and identifying a place or road specifically enough to act on. To both parties: this dispute is decided on the POL-RD-01 route-deviation threshold, and the outcome is NO_ACTION. The charge stands as billed, and no money moves.

1. The threshold test. The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is the trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 14.39 km (EV-GPS-02841) — not the rounded 14.4 km convenience copy on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02841), which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited for the test. Against the booked optimal of 12.0 km (EV-TRIP-02841), the excess is 2.39 km, which is 19.92% of the optimal distance. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The absolute limb passes (2.39 km > 0.8 km), but the percentage limb fails (19.92% is not greater than 20%), and both limbs must pass. No deviation is established on this trip's trace, however the trip feels to the rider. Both advocates' kept claims concede this, and the platform's own derived deviation block agrees (status: "no deviation").

2. The fare recomputation is therefore not reached. For completeness only: the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02841) shows a charged total of 20.64 SGD, and a POL-RD-02 recomputation against the booked optimal would give 18.08 SGD, i.e. a refund of 2.60 SGD payable — but POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is established, and it is not.

3. The driver's explanation — "a road works sign" — is an assertion of an external traffic cause. POL-RD-13 tests that against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and EV-ADVIS-02841-01 is MISSING with no payload and weight 0.0. The driver named no advisory evidence ID, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact: POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged on this ground, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route.

4. The remaining routes are closed on the record. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02841) carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction to exonerate distance under POL-RD-04. No endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02. The fare breakdown carries no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.0), so there is no pass-through or billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(2) or POL-RD-09(4). The driver's profile shows 0 deviation flags in the trailing 90 days over 196 completed trips (EV-DPROF-02841), so no POL-RD-06 pattern uplift or conduct referral arises; the rider's profile (EV-RPROF-02841) is below the POL-RD-08 corroboration threshold, so no extra corroboration is demanded of the rider either.

5. Integrity and escalation. The GPS trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 113 fixes, 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max gap 0 s (EV-GPS-02841), so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) does not engage and the excess is measured on the trace as recorded. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare ledger; timestamps are consistent and do not run backwards; confidence is above the 0.70 floor; and no charge line lacks a counterpart. The case is decidable, so no escalation issues.

Because the deviation fails its own gate, the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands: the fare of 20.64 SGD remains charged with no refund issued. The monetary effect (zero) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00 SGD. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days. The claims the referee discarded were discarded for non-disclosure of the missing advisory's issue code and do not bear on this result.
